objective: Make 900-second P0 utilization windows mechanically auditable from explicit observed substantive intervals rather than sparse checkpoint timestamps, then begin collecting only forward observed evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Same canonical continuation preserved before substantive work.
Evidence representation records observed interval boundaries and qualification basis without inferring historical coverage.
Promotion remains governed by control/evidence-policy.v1.json and control/rolling-window-promotion.v1.json.
No scheduler-only, heartbeat-only, waiting, or inferred interval is counted as useful work.
Checkpoint supports cold resume and same canonical remains verified.
checkpointable_substeps: Reconstruct epoch 33 and active evidence policies.
Persist explicit interval evidence representation or equivalent validator-ready schema.
Record first forward-only observed candidate evidence under the hardened representation.
Update utilization diagnosis/checkpoint without promoting an incomplete 900-second window.
handoff_boundary: After each durable control/state mutation; never backfill historical useful intervals.
early_finish_fallback: Add deterministic validation rules/examples that reject inferred boundaries and heartbeat/scheduler-only intervals.
progress_evidence: Same canonical continuation preserved and extended before substantive mutation.
Evidence policy and rolling-window promotion requirements re-read; historical interval inference remains forbidden.
